title: Our hawker centres deserve better than this
text:
Hawker centres are the best thing about this city, and it is a scandal that we treat them so casually.

Rents will surely keep climbing, and the stalls that make a neighbourhood worth living in will keep closing. Anyone who has queued for chicken rice on a Tuesday evening knows what is coming.

The authorities should publish a plan. They will not, of course, because nobody in a committee room has ever queued for anything. That is my honest view, and I expect the next few years to prove it right.

What would a fair system look like? It would be one where a stallholder can plan a decade ahead. We are nowhere near it, and I doubt we ever will be.
